messages:
nina-people-ops: Quick alert for hiring + payroll teams: migration weekend will overlap with our midmonth payroll. Two edge cases: 1) employees who terminate the week of cutover and request immediate rollover, and 2) mistaken roth/pre-tax conversions submitted during the blackout. Any guidance? @linda-benefits @omar-payroll

omar-payroll: For terminations: payroll will still produce final pay but if plan records aren’t live at vendor cutover the vendor may not process distributions until post-cutover. Recommend freeze outbound rollovers from 2035673600-2035677200 and handle as manual distributions after migration.

linda-benefits: Agreed. For rollover requests during blackout, ask employees to sign the rollover form but note we will process after cutover. For mistaken Roth<->pretax conversions submitted during blackout: we can reverse them but it requires tax corrections and vendor fees. Best to collect signed amendment and process post-migration.

nina-people-ops: Can payroll flag final checks so benefits team can prioritize those tickets after cutover?

omar-payroll: Yes. Use payroll flag: FINAL_CUTOFF for final pay tickets. Example ticket body to submit pre-cutover:

```
Employee: Jordan Lee (ID 56211)
Action: Termination final pay + request rollover (Vanguard IRA)
Payroll period: 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-10
Flag: FINAL_CUTOFF
Attach: signed rollover form
```

linda-benefits: For mistaken conversions we need: signed amendment, employee acknowledgement of tax impact, and copy of the (incorrect) vendor transaction reference. Use ticket code: RETRO_CONV_FIX. Mention: corrections could take 3-4 weeks.

paul-finance: Heads-up: manual rollovers and conversion reversals will create timing differences in cashflow and may affect monthly reconciliation. Please cc finance on FINAL_CUTOFF and RETRO_CONV_FIX tickets so we can forecast cash needs.

migration-bot: Migration blackout reminder: 2026-06-15 22:00 PT -> 2026-06-17 06:00 PT. Emergency tickets only during blackout. See migration playbook: https://internal.example.com/migration-playbook

nina-people-ops: Great — I'll post a short note to recruiting and hiring about pause on rollovers during the blackout and share the ticket templates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
